summary: Measurability and a uniform finite bound √#(K(g)∖Z) on the norm (each coset coordinate is a phase of modulus ≤ 1), the 𝖴-transformation from phase_besselU_mul, and the support condition from exists_of_inner_besselVector_ne_zero.

steps.claim: W_Z is continuous (measurable) and bounded by a uniform finite constant: ‖W_Z(y)‖ = (Σ_c |phase(g, y·a_c⁻¹)|²)^{1/2} ≤ √#(K(g)∖Z), each coset coordinate being a phase of modulus at most 1 (norm_phase_le_one; the bound is not 1); it transforms under 𝖴 by ψ(g⁻¹σ(u)) (phase_besselU_mul coordinatewise);
steps.lean:
⟨⟨⟨by fun_prop [IntermediateGroup.besselVector], _, fun x ↦ by
    grw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, IntermediateGroup.besselVector, norm_phase_le_one]⟩, by simp_all
  [IntermediateGroup.besselVector, phase_besselU_mul, PiLp.ext_iff]⟩,

steps.claim: and where W_Z(x) ≠ 0 there is u ∈ 𝖴 with ux ∈ K (the box of the lattice level).
